text.tspan: Harmon concludes, “The frequently allusive manner in which 2 Peter…
use[s] the OT assumes the reader is so familiar with those OT persons
and events that even a name or a brief phrase is enough to evoke the
entire OT context of that reference
It seems to Harmon that 2 Peter
does not so much directly quote (or cite) the OT as much as it does
allude to and (potentially) echo it. Harmon notes that the main way that
2 Peter uses the OT is by blending “Analogies and typology, with the
trade language from the OT” to describe false teachers
